Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori: Zekkouchou!

media.description: The second season of Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori. Rather than adapting the storybooks, this season focuses on an anime original arc of Puppe's search for the Minus Eel and Zorori's battle with The Legendary Prank King.

Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru".

The universe of strange and colorful creatures that are born, eat, are eaten… and are reborn indefinitely on the screen.

A short animation depicting a long and peaceful day of a cow. Small episodes of mystical and sweet characters (animals) by simple line drawings are amusing. She uses a touch which looks as though the pencil drawing has been rubbed with an eraser which makes viewers feel a unique texture. A work by a student.

Received a 11th Animation Division Encouragement Prize in the Japan Media Arts Festival.

title.romaji: Minami no Shima no Chiisana Hikouki Birdy

media.description:
This is Bird Paradise Island, a small island in the southern sea. Birdie is a newcomer and small plane that has been working at Bird Paradise Airport on this island for two years. Aiming to become the first airplane someday, he is working day and night on sightseeing flights with his rival Philip, a small helicopter, and his good friend, Annie, a goldfish-shaped helicopter. A small airplane, Birdy, and his funny and unique friends fly fast!

(Source: MyAnimeList)
